fields.Field Name (Local ES): Entidad informante
fields.Format: N (code 1 to 8)
fields.Field Explanation: A CODE, not a name. Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1 para. 3 prints the eight-value table: 1 Informante general, 2 Fiduciarias, 3 Mandatario y/o Administrador delegado, 4 Consorcio y/o Union Temporal, 5 Exploracion y Explotacion de hidrocarburos, gases y minerales, 6 Joint Venture, 7 Gestor en Cuentas en Participacion, 8 Agreements de cooperacion con entidades publicas. Par. 4 is categorical for payroll: 'cuando el employer reporte payments or credits in account por concept de employment income y de pensiones, la casilla Reporting entity se debe diligenciar con el concept 1 - Informante general', and the fideicomiso and contract-participant fields are then NOT filled.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (EN): Beneficiary document type and identification number
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Tipo de documento y numero de identificacion del beneficiario
fields.Format: N (code) + AN (number)
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD as drafted in the resolution - numeral 2 names BOTH the document type and the number in a single numeral, and the technical specification splits them into two columns. Sub-field 1 = the DIAN identity-document type code from the 'Tipo de documento (numerals 2 and 34)' table on the Field Options sheet; sub-field 2 = the identification number without dots or hyphens, kept as text so leading zeros survive. SOURCE: Employee.Document_Type and Employee.Document_Number in the employee master data. Where the master data holds no type-code field and stores the number in one column per document type (Citizenship Card ID, Identity Card for Foreigners, Identity Card, National ID), the engine holds an explicit Employee.Document_Type derived once from the populated column through the document-type mapping table, maintained as a configuration table that maps each master-data document column to one DIAN code of the 'Tipo de documento' table and fixes the priority order between the columns where more than one is filled; a document outside the DIAN table cannot be reported under another code. POPULATION: the record is required for EVERY person paid in the tax year, including leavers and employer-paid pensioners who are not active employees in the master data - their document type and number are retained after termination and held for every pensioner. Where a payment is made to a payee other than the employee (payroll field 'Beneficiary National Id', typically on pension payments), the identity reported is that of the beneficiary of the payment: a survivor or substitute pension is reported in a record in the name of the person who receives the pension, with that person's document type and number - the same identity rule as Form 220 casilla 50, issued in the recipient's name. PERSISTENCE: this pair is the join key across every Colombian artefact for the employee - electronic payroll NIE044 / NIE045, PILA Record Tipo 2 campos 3 and 4, Form 220 casillas 24 and 25.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Apellidos y nombres del beneficiario
fields.Format: A
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD. The resolution names one numeral; the technical specification splits it into four columns - first surname, second surname, first given name, other given names - in the same order as every other DIAN artefact. Sub-field order matters: DIAN matches on the surname columns. SOURCE: first surname = Master Data field 'Last Name'; second surname = Master Data field 'Second Last Name' (blank allowed); first given name = Master Data field 'First Name'; other given names = Master Data field 'Middle Name' (blank allowed). Do NOT use the formatted full name. The four name parts are retained for leavers and held for employer-paid pensioners, who are not active employees in the master data.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Ubicacion del beneficiario
fields.Conditional Reason: Country is always populated. Address, department and municipality are populated only where the country of residence is Colombia; for a beneficiary located outside Colombia they are left empty (Formato 2276 v4 technical specification, Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025).
fields.Format: AN (address) + N (DIVIPOLA department and municipality) + N (country code, DIAN country table)
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD - the beneficiary's location block of the Formato 2276 v4 technical specification (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025): address, department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) on the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue, and country. COUNTRY IS ALWAYS MANDATORY. Address, department and municipality are mandatory only where the country of residence is Colombia; for a beneficiary located outside Colombia only the country is reported and address, department and municipality are left empty. The country here is the country of the beneficiary's address, not a tax-residence marker. Note that this is the BENEFICIARY's location, not the place of work reported in the electronic payroll (NIE051 / NIE052) nor the place where the withholding was practised reported in Form 220 (casillas 34 / 35). Three artefacts, three different geographic questions. SOURCE: Employee.Department_Code and Employee.Municipality_Code, held as DIVIPOLA codes in the employee master data, with the address and the country taken from the same employee address record; where the master data holds a letter department code and a free-text city, the codes are obtained through the DIVIPOLA mapping table, maintained as a configuration table that maps each master-data department letter code and city name to its DANE department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) code, every entry validated against the DIVIPOLA catalogue. Free text must never be sent in the department, municipality or country sub-fields. Location is retained for leavers and held for employer-paid pensioners. The country is sent as the numeric code of the DIAN country table (attribute pais, int 4, 'de acuerdo con los definidos por resolución'), never as a name; Colombia is code 169. Department and municipality are sent with their leading zeros (attributes dpto int 2 and mun int 3, 'debe incluir los ceros a la izquierda').
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por salarios
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Annual salary payments to the employee: ordinary and integral salary (100% of the integral salary - the 70% factor applies only to contribution bases), salary arrears, overtime and surcharges, habitual bonuses, and other remuneration that constitutes salary under CST art. 127 and is not reported in a more specific numeral. Habitual bonuses - bonuses paid regularly as part of the remuneration, whatever their label - are reported here; a non-habitual, one-off bonus is reported in numeral 17 (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, elements pasa and potro). Payments in kind that constitute salary (CST arts. 127 and 129) are reported here (element pasa); payments in kind that are not salary are reported in numeral 17 (element potro); the salary attribute of each in-kind wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC). Fed by an explicit wage-type-to-numeral classification table, NOT by the payroll 'salary' indicator, which also marks items that belong to other numerals (vacation pay, numeral 12; per diems, numeral 13 - every per diem, including a permanent salary-type per diem, element pavia). Each wage type feeds exactly one numeral. Accumulated on the PAYMENT date for 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; rolling or non-calendar accumulators must not be used. Maps to Form 220 casilla 36, which likewise carries the habitual bonuses, and must equal it for the same employee and year.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por emolumentos eclesiasticos
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employer paid ecclesiastical emoluments. Distinct from 'Fee payments' (numeral 9) even though Form 220 combines the two.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: A SEPARATE NUMERAL HERE, with no counterpart casilla on Form 220 (Form 220 folds ecclesiastical emoluments into casilla 39, fees). Payments in money or in kind, direct or indirect, compensating the personal service of a minister of religion, whatever the denomination and whatever the creed.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Payments made with vouchers, cheques, cards or vales
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos realizados con bonos electronicos o de papel de servicio, cheques, tarjetas, vales, etc.
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where such payments were made AND the amount is not already reported under any other numeral (par. 6), and for meal payments to a third party for an employee whose monthly salary exceeds 310 UVT (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pabop). Bidirectional exclusion with every other numeral of the format.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Payments in vouchers, cheques, cards or vales. Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1 para. 6 imposes a HARD EXCLUSION: 'El value reportado en el numeral 7 NO DEBE CONTENER la information reportada en los demas numerales del Format 2276'. It is a residual concept, and double-reporting it against numerals 5, 8 or 17 is a validation failure. Meal payments to a third party for an employee whose monthly salary exceeds 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026) are reported HERE, because the ET art. 387-1 exclusion does not apply to that employee (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pabop); for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT the same payment is split at 41 UVT between numeral 32 (element pagahuvt) and numeral 8 (element vaex) and nothing comes here. The 310-UVT test is applied month by month.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Excess meal payments over 41 UVT (ET art. 387-1)
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor del exceso de los pagos por alimentacion mensuales mayores a 41 UVT, articulo 387-1 E.T.
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where monthly meal payments to a third party exceed 41 UVT. Bidirectional pair with numeral 32 (the amount up to 41 UVT). The whole benefit is unavailable where the employee's monthly salary exceeds 310 UVT, in which case the payment falls to numeral 7 instead.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: The EXCESS over 41 UVT per month (COP 2,147,334 in 2026) of employer payments to third parties for the employee's or their family's meals, for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026) - ET art. 387-1; Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element vaex. Taxable income of the employee. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 32 (element pagahuvt), which carries the amount UP TO 41 UVT and is informative only - the same underlying payment is split across two numerals at the 41-UVT line, and the engine must maintain that split monthly. Where the monthly salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole meal payment is reported in numeral 7 (element pabop) and this numeral stays nil for that month.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por honorarios
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where fees were paid AND the payment was withheld under ET art. 383 (art. 383 par. 2, added by Ley 2277 de 2022 art. 8). Where art. 383 did not apply, the payment belongs in a different format, not here.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Fees paid to a natural person. Res. 227 para. 5 is the governing rule: payments to natural persons receiving work income NOT arising from an employment, legal or statutory relationship, but subject to withholding under ET art. 383, ARE reported in Format 2276. Where such a payment is NOT subject to art. 383 withholding, it is reported instead in the ordinary payments-and-withholdings formats.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por servicios
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where services were paid AND withheld under ET art. 383.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Service payments to a natural person, subject to the same par. 5 test as numeral 9.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por comisiones
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where non-employment commissions were paid AND withheld under ET art. 383. Mutually exclusive with numeral 5 for the same amount.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Commissions to a natural person, subject to the same par. 5 test. Commissions paid UNDER an employment contract are salary under CST art. 127 and belong in numeral 5.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por prestaciones sociales
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Statutory benefits OTHER THAN severance and its interest, which have their own three numerals (18, 19, 20): legal service bonus (prima de servicios), vacation pay (enjoyed, compensated in cash, or paid on termination) and work clothing. Fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification; a wage type classified here is excluded from numeral 5 even where it carries the salary flag in payroll (e.g. vacation pay). Extralegal bonuses (e.g. vacation bonus, March/Christmas/August bonuses) are not reported here: a bonus paid habitually goes to numeral 5 and a non-habitual, one-off bonus goes to numeral 17 (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, elements pasa and potro); the habitual / non-habitual attribute of each bonus wage type is carried in the classification table. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Maps to Form 220 casilla 42.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por viaticos
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where per diems were paid in the year.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Per diems for transport, subsistence and accommodation away from the habitual workplace, fed by the per-diem wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification (e.g. hotel, breakfast, lunch and dinner per diem wage types). Every per diem is reported in this numeral (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pavia), including permanent, salary-type per diems that carry the payroll salary flag; no per-diem wage type is routed to numeral 5, and each amount is reported in one numeral only. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Maps to Form 220 casilla 43, which likewise carries every per diem.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por gastos de representacion
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where representation expenses were paid in the year.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Representation expenses. Maps to Form 220 casilla 44.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por compensaciones por el trabajo asociado cooperativo
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only for a member of an associated-work cooperative.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Compensation for associated cooperative work. Applies only to a member of an associated-work cooperative - PILA contributor type 31 and electronic payroll TipoTrabajador 31. Maps to Form 220 casilla 45.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Non-reimbursable educational support financed with public funds
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor apoyos economicos no reembolsables o condonados, entregados por el Estado o financiados con recursos publicos, para financiar programas educativos
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employer paid the support DIRECTLY. Where a third party administers it, report Format 5247 concept 5102 and leave this numeral nil - the two are mutually exclusive for the same payment.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Non-reimbursable or forgiven educational support from the State or financed with public funds. Res. 227 para. 7 draws the line by WHO ADMINISTERS IT: where the EMPLOYER pays it directly it is reported here; where a THIRD PARTY administers it, it is reported in Format 5247 under concept 5102 instead. Par. 7 was added by Resolution 188 of 2024 art. 8 and, under para. 5 of art. 1.3.9.1.3, first applies to tax year 2025, filed in calendar 2026.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Otros pagos
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where a work-income payment has no dedicated numeral: non-habitual bonuses, one-off payments to a retiree that are not a pension, and the other items listed in the Field Explanation (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element potro).
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Work-income payments with no dedicated numeral (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element potro): non-habitual, one-off bonuses (a habitual bonus goes to numeral 5, element pasa), non-salary allowances, payments in kind that are not salary - including payments to third parties for the employee's benefit - (a payment in kind that constitutes salary goes to numeral 5, element pasa; the salary attribute of each in-kind wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC)), equity-based compensation, termination indemnities, and one-off payments to a retiree that are not a pension - a retirement gratuity, a pension-related compensation or settlement - while the pension itself goes to numeral 21 (element peju). Fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Exclude advances, loans, expense reimbursements and other entries that are not income of the beneficiary. Informative wage types paid to third parties (the 'Inf.' wage types) and foreign-paid wage types are classified wage type by wage type on the same attributes: a wage type that is income of the beneficiary is reported in numeral 5 where it carries the salary attribute and here where it does not, whatever the payment channel; a wage type that records no income of the beneficiary (e.g. a reimbursement or an employer-cost informative entry) is excluded; a meal payment to a food supplier follows the numeral 7 / 8 / 32 rule; and the income of a non-resident for work performed entirely outside Colombia is foreign-source and is not reported in this return (DIAN Official letter 28380 of 2019). Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Note the interaction with par. 6: numeral 7 must not repeat anything reported here.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ the three severance lines(numerals 18, 19, 20) - order differs from form 220 ═══
Severance and interest actually paid to the employee
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Cesantias e intereses de cesantias efectivamente pagadas al empleado
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Cesantias_Paid_To_Employee [WTC: CO-CESANTIAS + CO-INTERESES-CESANTIAS, see CO-DIAN-004 row 38 for the same field]
fields.Field Explanation: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE NUMERALS. Amounts ACTUALLY PAID to the employee - the January interest payment, an authorised partial withdrawal, or a termination settlement. Maps to Form 220 casilla 47.
fields.Option Values: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de severance savings
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Severance deposited to the severance fund
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Cesantias consignadas al fondo de cesantias
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated for an employee under the Ley 50 de 1990 regime. Mutually exclusive with 'Severance under the traditional CST regime' (numeral 20) for the same employee. Must reconcile to the deposit made under CO-CESANTIAS-006 in the reported year - the February deposit belongs to the year of the deposit (ET art. 27 num. 3).
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: THE SECOND OF THREE. The severance DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen fund under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99, counted in the year in which the deposit is MADE (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element ceco; ET art. 27 num. 3): the deposit made by 14 February of the reported year, for the severance accrued in the preceding year, belongs to the reported year, and the deposit made in February of the following year belongs to that following year. MAPS TO FORM 220 CASILLA 49, which follows the same deposit-year rule, while numeral 20 maps to casilla 48. The second and third severance lines are TRANSPOSED between the two artefacts, and a positional mapping swaps them.
fields.Option Values: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de severance savings
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Severance recognised under the traditional CST regime
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Auxilio de cesantias reconocido a trabajadores del regimen tradicional del Codigo Sustantivo del Trabajo, contenido en el Capitulo VII, Titulo VIII Parte Primera
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only for an employee under the pre-1991 traditional regime. Mutually exclusive with 'Severance deposited to the fund' (numeral 19) for the same employee.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Cesantias_Traditional_Regime [No dedicated WTC code -- a regime-eligibility flag, not a wage type; see CO-DIAN-004 row 39]
fields.Field Explanation: THE THIRD OF THREE. Severance RECOGNISED under the pre-1991 retroactive regime, for employees hired before 1 January 1991 who did not elect the Law 50 of 1990 regime. MAPS TO FORM 220 CASILLA 48 - NOT casilla 49.
fields.Option Values: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de severance savings
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pensiones de jubilacion, vejez o invalidez
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employer itself paid a pension.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER (retirement, old-age or invalidity). Populated for every employer-paid pensioner: where the employer pays company pensions directly through payroll (monthly pension and additional pension wage types), this numeral is populated and the pensioner population, which is not part of the active employee master data, is included in the file. Fed by the pension wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Only the pension itself - the periodic retirement, old-age or invalidity pension payments - is reported here (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element peju); a lump-sum or one-off payment to a retiree that is not a pension (a retirement gratuity, a pension-related compensation or settlement) is reported in numeral 17 (element potro). A survivor or substitute pension paid by the employer is reported in the record of the person who receives it, identified in numeral 2 with the recipient's own document type and number - not in a record of the deceased pensioner - the same identity rule as Form 220 casilla 50, issued in the recipient's name. Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Where a fund pays the pension, the fund is the withholding agent and reporting party and nothing is reported here.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Total gross income from work or pension payments
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Total ingresos brutos por pagos de rentas de trabajo o pensiones
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: The gross total. Maps to Form 220 casilla 52 and must equal it for the same employee and year. Note that numeral 32 (meal payments up to 41 UVT) is INFORMATIVE and does NOT enter this total - para. 1 says so expressly.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ employee contributions and voluntary savings(numerals 23 to 28) ═══
Mandatory health contributions borne by the employee
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Aportes obligatorios por salud a cargo del trabajador
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: The beneficiary's own mandatory health contributions actually deducted in the tax year, by payment date. Source: the employee EPS contribution wage type (WT 2554), taken from the contribution wage type itself - never from a combined EPS+AFP+FSP total. On the record of an employer-paid pensioner, the mandatory health contribution deducted from the pension (the pensioner EPS wage types) is reported here in the same way (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element apos). Maps to Form 220 casilla 53 and must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE163 and to the employee portion of PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 55.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Mandatory pension and solidarity-fund contributions borne by the employee
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Aportes obligatorios a fondos de pensiones y solidaridad pensional a cargo del trabajador
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Pension AND the solidarity-fund surcharge (both the solidarity and the subsistence sub-accounts) in ONE numeral, exactly as Form 220 casilla 54 combines them. Source: the employee AFP contribution wage type plus the FSP wage type (WT 2556 + WT 2553), never a combined EPS+AFP+FSP figure. On the record of an employer-paid pensioner, the solidarity-fund deduction on the pension is reported here (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element apof). The electronic payroll and PILA both keep pension and FSP separate, so the engine must sum only at this point.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Voluntary contributions to the individual-account regime (RAIS)
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Aportes voluntarios al Regimen de Ahorro Individual con Solidaridad (RAIS)
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where the employee made voluntary RAIS contributions. Distinct from 'Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds' (numeral 26) - different legal bases, and the electronic payroll cannot tell them apart (one element, NIE198).
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Voluntary contributions to the mandatory individual-account regime (RAIS) under ET art. 55. DISTINCT from numeral 26. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the attribute 'RAIS voluntary (art. 55)'. The art. 55 / art. 126-1 attribute of each voluntary-pension deduction wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC), across the '(FVOL)' provider wage types 25811-25815 and 25823 and the institutional-plan wage types 25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803 and 65804 - each of which carries exactly one of the two attributes, art. 55 (numeral 25) or art. 126-1 (numeral 26). A combined APV total is never used as the source. Maps to Form 220 casilla 55.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Aportes voluntarios a fondos de pensiones voluntarias
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where the employee made voluntary pension-fund contributions. Distinct from numeral 25.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1. Source: voluntary-pension deduction wage types carrying the attribute 'voluntary pension fund (art. 126-1)'. The art. 55 / art. 126-1 attribute of each voluntary-pension deduction wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC), across the '(FVOL)' provider wage types (25811-25815, 25823) and the institutional-plan wage types (25820, 25821, 21210, 21211, 65803, 65804). Employee contributions deducted through payroll are reported here; employer contributions to institutional plans are distinguished from them through the employer- / employee-side attribute of each institutional-plan wage type (including the payment / bonus entries 65803 and 65804), which also comes from the WTC. Maps to Form 220 casilla 56.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Aportes a cuentas AFC
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where AFC deductions were made.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Ahorro para el Fomento de la Construccion: the employee's AFC contributions withheld through payroll in the tax year, by payment date. Source: the AFC deduction wage types (one wage type per bank, 'AFC <bank>'), summed across banks. A reimbursement / reversal wage type ('Reimbursement AFC') reverses an AFC deduction through payroll and is netted against the AFC deductions of the same tax year, so that the numeral carries the net amount actually withheld for the AFC account in the year (ET art. 126-4 counts the sums deposited in the account); the annual net value is reported as a positive integer, zero where the net is nil (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025). Maps to Form 220 casilla 57 and to electronic payroll NIE179.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Aportes a cuentas AVC
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where AVC deductions to the FNA were made.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Voluntary savings Contractual with the Fondo Nacional del Ahorro. Maps to Form 220 casilla 58. The electronic payroll has NO dedicated element for AVC - it falls to OtraDeduccion (NIE197) - so the wage type must be tagged to recover the amount here.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Withholding on work or pension income
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor de las retenciones en la fuente por pagos de rentas de trabajo o pensiones
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING NUMERAL: the income-tax withholding ACTUALLY PRACTISED on the beneficiary's work or pension income in the tax year, by payment date (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element vare). For a RESIDENT it is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Source: every wage type that records withholding actually practised and remitted - the employee income-tax wage type and the separate withholding wage types for terminations, retirees and equity awards. Hypothetical, notional or theoretical amounts are excluded: a tax-equalisation amount enters only to the extent it was actually withheld and declared on Form 350, and the contingent withholding of ET arts. 126-1 and 126-4, which the fund practises on a withdrawal, is never included. Maps to Form 220 casilla 60, likewise the withholding actually practised, and the sum across the population reconciles to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): VAT as a higher cost or expense
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA), mayor valor del costo o gasto
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated by the employer's tax function, outside payroll, where non-deductible VAT attached to the payment. Payroll contributes nothing.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Non-deductible VAT treated as a higher cost or expense. Not a payroll figure; present in the format because Format 2276 is a third-party information return covering all art. 383 work income, including payments to contractors.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Retencion en la fuente a titulo de Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA)
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated by the employer's tax function, outside payroll, where VAT was withheld from the payment. Payroll contributes nothing.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: VAT withheld on the payment. Not a payroll figure - Colombian employment income carries no VAT. Relevant only where the beneficiary is a VAT-responsible contractor paid under the art. 383 table.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Monthly meal payments up to 41 UVT
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos por alimentacion mensuales hasta 41 UVT
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where the employer made meal payments to a third party for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT. Bidirectional pair with numeral 8 (the excess). Where the salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole payment falls to numeral 7 and BOTH this numeral and numeral 8 stay nil.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.Field Explanation: INFORMATIVE ONLY. Res. 227 para. 1: the value of numeral 32 is informative and corresponds to ET art. 387-1. It does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 8 (element vaex), which carries the excess above 41 UVT. Form 220 has NO counterpart casilla. Computed MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the meal payment to a third party up to 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), only in months where the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026); where the salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole payment is reported in numeral 7 (element pabop) and this numeral stays nil (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pagahuvt). Source: the meal-allowance-in-kind wage type(s) carrying the 'meal paid to a third party' attribute (e.g. 'Meal Allowance Inf.'); the attribute comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC) and is carried only by meal payments made to a food supplier.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Average labour income of the last six months
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor ingreso laboral promedio de los ultimos seis meses. Unicamente para trabajadores que aplique el numeral 4 articulo 206 E.T.
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated ONLY for employees to whom ET art. 206 num. 4 applies - that is, where severance or its interest was paid or deposited. Bidirectional with numerals 18, 19 and 20: a record carrying any of those three should carry this average.
fields.Format: N (positive integer: whole pesos, no decimals, no sign, no separators; zero when nil)
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Rolling_6M_Average_Labour_Income [Calculated: rolling 6-month average -- no dedicated WTC code; see CO-DIAN-004 row 51]
fields.Field Explanation: The rolling six-month average that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper - full exemption where it does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026). The resolution restricts it expressly: 'UNICAMENTE para employees que aplique el numeral 4 art. 206 E.T.'. The engine must maintain the average YEAR-ROUND; it cannot be reconstructed from annual totals.
fields.Rounding: Positive integer in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2).

fields.Field Name (EN): Economic dependant document type and identification number
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Tipo de documento y numero de identificacion del dependiente economico
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employee claimed the ET art. 387 para. 2 dependants deduction during the year. Bidirectional with Form 220 casillas 79 to 82, which carry the same dependant with the addition of the name and relationship.
fields.Format: N (code) + AN (number)
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD - document type and number of the economic dependant claimed under ET art. 387 para. 2. Sub-field 1 = document type code; sub-field 2 = the number. THIS IS THE FIELD DIAN USES TO CROSS-CHECK a dependant claimed by more than one taxpayer, which is why it must agree with Form 220 casillas 79 and 80 exactly.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Identificacion del fideicomiso
fields.Conditional Reason: MANDATORY where 'Reporting entity concept' (numeral 1) = 2 (Fiduciarias); MUST BE BLANK where numeral 1 = 1 (Informante general). Mutually exclusive with 'Contract participant document type and identification' (numeral 36). Bidirectional set with numeral 1.
fields.Format: N (digits only; annex attribute identfc, XSD pattern [0-9]{0,14})
fields.Field Explanation: Populated ONLY where the reporting entity concept (numeral 1) is 2 - Fiduciarias - because the work income was paid out of trust assets. Res. 227 para. 4 directs that for an ordinary employer reporting under concept 1 this field 'no se debe diligenciar'.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (EN): Contract participant document type and identification number
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Tipo documento e identificacion del participante en contrato
fields.Conditional Reason: MANDATORY where 'Reporting entity concept' (numeral 1) is 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 or 8; MUST BE BLANK where numeral 1 = 1 or 2. Mutually exclusive with 'Trust identification' (numeral 35). Bidirectional set with numeral 1.
fields.Format: N (code) + AN (number)
fields.Field Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD, populated ONLY where the reporting entity concept (numeral 1) is a collaboration-contract concept - 3 Mandatario, 4 Consorcio o Union Temporal, 5 Exploracion y explotacion, 6 Joint Venture, 7 Gestor en Cuentas en Participacion, 8 Agreements de cooperacion. Res. 227 para. 4 directs that for concept 1 it 'no se debe diligenciar', and that where a collaboration contract IS reported, the trust field (numeral 35) is left blank instead.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ filing control fields(not numerals - envelope and deadline drivers) ═══

fields.Field Name (Local ES): NIT del informante
fields.Format: N
fields.Field Explanation: NIT of the reporting employer. Res. 227 art. 1.3.9.1.3 keys the DEADLINE to it: the LAST digit for a Gran Taxpayer, the LAST TWO digits for a legal or natural person. This is a third deadline rule, different again from Form 350 (last digit, 7th-16th business day) and PILA (last two digits, 2nd-16th business day).
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Calidad del informante
fields.Format: Code
fields.Field Explanation: Gran Taxpayer, persona legal entity or equivalent, or natural person y asimilada. Res. 227 art. 1.3.9.1.3 para. 1 fixes the point at which it is tested: 'de acuerdo con la calidad de Gran Taxpayer, legal entity o natural person QUE SE POSEA EN EL MOMENTO DE INFORMAR' - the status held at the moment of filing, not at the year end being reported.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Ano gravable
fields.Format: N (AAAA)
fields.Field Explanation: The fiscal year whose payments are reported (AAAA). Every amount numeral (5 to 33) is the sum of payments or credits in account made between 1 January and 31 December of this year, by PAYMENT date - never a rolling twelve-month window or an accumulator spanning two calendar years. Filed in May or June of the FOLLOWING calendar year. In the XML header (element Cab, Anexo T3.45) the tax year is carried by FecInicial and FecFinal - the first and last day of the tax year reported, format AAAA-MM-DD - while the header attribute Ano is the YEAR OF SENDING (año de envío, the same aaaa as in the file name), not the tax year: for the 2026 return filed in 2027, Ano = 2027, FecInicial = 2026-01-01 and FecFinal = 2026-12-31.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Formato y version
fields.Format: Code
fields.Field Explanation: A CONSTANT for this filing: Format 2276, version 4, carried in the file name as mmmmm = 02276 and vv = 04 (Dmuisca_ccmmmmmvvaaaacccccccc.xml). Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1 lists it in the formats-and-technical-specifications table as T3.45. A version mismatch is rejected at upload.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
